author: tvami
body:
#### PR description:

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52122

In `*SAN` IBs, unit tests run with `LD_PRELOAD=libasan.so`. The preload is passed down to `sed` inside the `/cvmfs/cms.cern.ch/common/dasgoclient` wrapper. `sed` leaks 1 byte in `compile_program`, and LeakSanitizer writes a report to stderr. The client still exits 0 and returns valid JSON, but both callers treat the stderr as part of the DAS result:

- `Utilities/General/python/cmssw_das_client.py`: stderr is no longer merged into the output parsed by `json.loads()`. On failure, the error reason includes both stdout and stderr.
- `PhysicsTools/Utilities/scripts/edmPickEvents.py`: a DAS failure is decided by the exit code instead of non-empty stderr. The script now uses `communicate()`.

#### PR validation:

Tested in `CMSSW_20_1_ASAN_X_2026-10-07-2300`:

- `test_edmPickEvents` failed before the fix with the same LSAN "DAS error" as the IB. It passes after the fix.
- `testJetMETCorrectionsType1MET` only queries DAS on CERN/FNAL hosts. Its input lookup (`testInputFiles_cff`) was run with ASAN preloaded and the real DAS server. Before the fix it failed with `JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 2 column 1 (char 1)`; after the fix it runs without error. Without the preload, the old and new code return identical results.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport, no backport foreseen.
title: Ignore stderr noise in DAS calls
